# amig0

> AI-powered travel discovery platform — city guides, bookable group experiences, and local member deals.

amig0 helps travelers explore cities with AI-generated recommendations, book group services with a small deposit, and access exclusive local deals through a membership. Available at amig0.com.

## What amig0 Provides

- **Traveler Hacks**: AI-generated city travel guides covering food, drinks, activities, and neighborhoods. Available for 23+ cities worldwide.
- **Bookable Services**: Reserve group experiences — e-bike rentals, luxury photo booths, and mobile bar service — with a small deposit ($10–$35).
- **amig0 Membership**: $3.99/month subscription granting exclusive deals and perks at verified local partner venues.
- **Partner Network**: Local restaurants, bars, and experiences can apply to join the amig0 partner network.

## Public Pages

- [Traveler Hacks](https://amig0.com/hacks): AI travel recommendations by city
- [Partner Application](https://amig0.com/business): Apply to become an amig0 partner
